blocks.name: $if
blocks.note: A branch, emitted as a Beans if. A branch that is not taken contributes no element, so the siblings after it shift — give them key={ } if that matters.

blocks.name: else
blocks.note: Written without a $, because it continues the $if that opened the block.

blocks.name: $for
blocks.note: A loop, emitted as a Beans for. A child carrying key={ } keeps its control across reordering; without one, rows match by position.

blocks.name: $match
blocks.note: A branch with more than two arms. At least one arm is required.

blocks.name: $slot
blocks.note: Places or defines a template. A body makes it a definition and only reads that way inside a component tag; the other four place one, and a component declares each template as an fn(Builder) field.

interpolations.name: $<chain>
interpolations.note: An implicit chain. It ends where the chain ends, so $5.00 and US$ are ordinary text.
A parenthesised expression. One line: a newline inside it is refused.
A braced expression. One line, and a } in running text closes an enclosing block, so write \} for a literal one.

namespaces.name: on:

namespaces.name: bind:

bindings.name: bind:value

reservedAttributes.name: key
reservedAttributes.note: The identity of this element among its siblings, across renders. A keyed element keeps its control when the list around it is reordered or filtered; without one, siblings match by position. It also names the control for Stage.control(key) and Stage.widget(key) in on_mount.

reservedAttributes.name: ref
reservedAttributes.note: On a component tag only: the instance the tag built, assigned to a place of type Option<T> once the tag is fully configured. A control has no instance to hand back — name it with key= instead.
